metadata.name: Claude of Duty
metadata.description: A procedural first-person shooter in Three.js: wave survival on a market street where every texture, mesh, animation and sound is generated from code at load time. Hand-written post-processing (SSAO, bloom, god rays, ACES grade, FXAA), procedural characters and weapons. Full keyboard/mouse and iPad touch controls.
